list.title: Ethiopian Yirgacheffe Grade 1
list.description: A light roast with distinct floral notes of jasmine and bright acidity. Perfect for pour-over enthusiasts.

reviews.description: Absolutely stunning floral aroma. The best beans I've bought this year.
A bit too acidic for my taste, tasted almost like lemon juice. Clearly high quality, just not for me.
Brewed this in my Chemex and the jasmine notes were incredible.
Good beans, but slightly uneven roast compared to the last batch.
Very tea-like body. If you like heavy coffee, skip this. If you like complexity, buy it.
Way too sour for my morning routine.
The blueberry finish is subtle but definitely there.

list.title: Sumatra Mandheling Reserve
list.description: Full-bodied, earthy, and low acidity. Deep herbal notes with a smooth chocolate finish.

reviews.description: Exactly the bold, earthy flavor I was looking for.
A bit too muddy for my taste, lacked clarity.
Perfect for French Press. Thick and syrupy.
Low acid is a lifesaver for my stomach. Love it.
Tasted a bit burnt rather than roasted.
Rich dark chocolate notes, great with milk.
My go-to morning coffee. Strong and wakes you up.

list.title: Precision Burr Grinder X1
list.description: Stainless steel conical burrs ensure a consistent grind size for everything from Espresso to French Press.

reviews.description: Grinds evenly, but the motor is a bit louder than I expected.
Game changer for my morning routine. Worth every penny.
Retention is high, I have to tap it a lot to get all the grounds out.
Beautiful design on my counter and the grind consistency is top notch.
Stopped working after 6 months. Customer service was slow.
Great for pour over, struggles a bit with fine espresso.
Easy to clean and assemble.

list.title: Colombian Supremo Huila
list.description: The classic breakfast coffee. Medium roast with notes of caramel, walnut, and red apple.

reviews.description: Solid coffee, but nothing exciting. Good for daily drinking.
Very consistent. I buy this every month.
Smooth, nutty, no bitter aftertaste.
Bought this for the office, everyone loves it.
A bit stale when it arrived.
Classic Colombian taste. Can't go wrong.
Great price for the quality.

list.title: Raw Green Beans: Kenya AA
list.description: Premium unroasted green beans for home roasting enthusiasts. High density and massive flavor potential.

reviews.description: Clean beans, very few defects. Roasted to a City+ and it was perfect.
High moisture content, took a while to reach first crack.
Produced a lovely bright cup. Will buy again.
Too many quakers in the bag.
Excellent size consistency.
Hard to roast evenly for a beginner, but that's on me.
Great packaging, beans stayed fresh.

list.title: V60 Ceramic Dripper 02
list.description: The standard for manual brewing. Spiraled ribs allows for maximum coffee expansion.

reviews.description: Arrived chipped, had to return it. Replacement works fine.
Keeps heat well, makes a clean cup.
Looks great on the shelf and easy to clean.
The flow rate is perfect.
I broke it within a week. Get the plastic one if you're clumsy.
Essential tool for any coffee lover.
Too small for my large mug.

list.title: Midnight Espresso Blend
list.description: A mix of Brazilian and Vietnamese beans designed for thick crema and a punchy caffeine kick.

reviews.description: Cuts through milk perfectly in my cappuccino.
Great crema production, looks amazing in the cup.
A little too bitter for a straight shot.
This stuff is strong! Love the caffeine kick.
Good value blend.
Lacks nuance, it's just a punch in the face.
Easy to dial in on my machine.

list.title: Gooseneck Variable Kettle
list.description: Precise temperature control and a thin spout for exact pouring control.

reviews.description: Heats up fast and holds temp perfectly.
Buttons feel a bit cheap.
The flow control is unmatched.
Also great for tea since you can set lower temps.
Display died after a month.
Looks sleek in matte black.
Takes a while to boil if filled to max.

list.title: Home Drum Roaster Kit
list.description: An entry-level motorized drum roaster for stovetops. Roasts up to 300g at a time.

reviews.description: Hard to control the heat, burned my first two batches.
Fun project, but requires patience.
Good for learning, but you will outgrow it fast.
Once you get the hang of it, the results are great.
The motor is a bit weak for a full 300g load.
Best option for this price range.
Smokes up the kitchen, use good ventilation!

list.title: Costa Rica Tarrazu
list.description: Honey processed beans yielding a sweet, complex body with hints of brown sugar.

reviews.description: Incredibly sweet even without sugar. My favorite.
Very balanced cup.
Smooth and gentle on the stomach.
It was okay, expected more complexity.
Love the processing method, unique flavor.
Packaging is beautiful, makes a great gift.
Overpriced for what it is.

list.title: Classic French Press
list.description: Heat-resistant borosilicate glass with a triple-screen filter system.

reviews.description: Simple, effective, and easy to clean.
Glass is very thin, broke in the sink.
The triple filter really keeps the sludge out.
Makes the best full-bodied coffee.
Dishwasher safe, which is a huge plus.
I prefer stainless steel, keeps coffee hotter.
Cheap and does the job.

list.title: Decaf Mountain Water Process
list.description: Chemical-free decaffeination. Notes of cinnamon and chocolate. You won't believe it's decaf.

reviews.description: Finally a decaf that doesn't taste like cardboard!
I can drink this at 9pm and sleep like a baby.
A bit weak compared to regular beans, but good.
Still has that weird decaf aftertaste.
Saved my life during pregnancy.
Excellent chocolate notes.
My guests didn't know it was decaf.

list.title: Raw Green Beans: Brazil Santos
list.description: A forgiving bean for beginner roasters. Naturally low acidity and nutty flavor profile.

reviews.description: Great price for practicing. Hard to mess this one up.
Very nutty flavor, great for blending.
A bit boring on its own, needs to be blended.
I buy this in bulk, consistent quality.
Produces a lot of chaff during roasting.
Takes a dark roast very well.
Unbeatable value.

list.title: Guatemala Antigua Volcanic
list.description: Grown in volcanic soil, this coffee has a spicy, smoky character with a heavy body.

reviews.description: Rich and spicy. A wonderful afternoon cup.
The smoky flavor is distinct and delicious.
Too intense for me.
Pairs perfectly with a chocolate dessert.
Authentic Antigua flavor.
Bag ripped during shipping.
Good body, low acid.

list.title: Digital Coffee Scale
list.description: Measures down to 0.1g with a built-in timer for pour-over accuracy.

reviews.description: Display is dim and hard to read in sunlight.
Accurate enough for the price.
There is a delay in the weight reading, annoying for espresso.
Love the built-in timer function.
Eats batteries like crazy.
Good starter scale.
Not waterproof, be careful!

list.title: Cold Brew Coarse Blend
list.description: Pre-ground coarse blend specifically roasted to be steeped cold for 24 hours.

reviews.description: Makes a super smooth concentrate.
Love that it comes pre-ground coarse. Saves me time.
Chocolatey and zero bitterness.
I prefer grinding my own beans fresh.
Add some oat milk and it's heaven.
Wish it came in larger bags.
Found it a bit bitter, maybe I steeped too long.

list.title: Infrared Thermometer Gun
list.description: Essential for checking bean temperature during the roasting process.

reviews.description: Works instantly. Very helpful.
Seems to be off by a few degrees compared to my probe.
I use this for my pizza oven too!
Feels plasticky but works.
Laser pointer helps aim.
Arrived with a cracked screen.
Instant readings, good response time.

list.title: Blue Mountain Style Blend
list.description: A recreation of the famous Jamaica Blue Mountain flavor profile at a fraction of the cost.

reviews.description: Good attempt, but lacks the true silkiness of the real thing.
For the price, this is an amazing cup of coffee.
Close enough to bring back memories of my trip.
Just marketing hype. It's a standard mild blend.
Very smooth, zero bite.
Got this as a gift, loved it.
Tasty but expensive.

list.title: AeroPress Coffee Maker
list.description: The ultimate travel coffee maker. Indestructible, fast, and makes a very clean cup.

reviews.description: I take this camping everywhere. Best invention ever.
It doesn't make real espresso, but the coffee is strong.
Too many parts to keep track of.
Makes the cleanest cup of coffee I've ever had.
Use the inverted method for best results!
Don't like brewing in plastic.
Fastest way to make a single cup.

list.title: Monsoon Malabar
list.description: Exposed to monsoon rains and winds, resulting in a low-acid, heavy-bodied, unique spicy flavor.

reviews.description: Very unique taste. A bit musty, but in a good way.
Tastes like old socks. Not for me.
Love the spicy notes, very different from African coffees.
The lowest acidity coffee I've ever found.
Produces amazing crema in espresso blends.
Interesting to try once, but wouldn't drink daily.
Reminds me of coffee I had in Europe.
